notes.title: Achievements Fix!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! We have some good news, achievements have been fixed!! ːsteamthumbsupː ːsteamhappyː

We were able to adjust some of the old achievements that players have reported in the past. You should be able to start the game and get credit for achivements like 'It's Sticky' if you have the preogress but never unlocked the Steam achievement.

Let us know if you still have any troubles with the old achievements, and thank you so much for supporting Saturday Morning RPG! ː2015hollyː

notes.title: Play as Marty in Cylinder: Puzzles Returned!
notes.notes:
We are excited to have Marty as a playable character in our new game Cylinder: Puzzles Returned!

This is a cool crossover where Michael "Marty" Martin Hall brings plenty of fun nods to Saturday Morning RPG. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5525597/998c024277e049e2beecc005f7123c85e899ec5b.png[/img]

Make sure to check him out in Cylinder:Puzzles Returned, and thank you for playing our games!

notes.title: Check out our new game Cylinder: Puzzles Returned!
notes.notes:
Hey Everyone!

We have a new game nearing completion, and the demo is available now! Please check out our new puzzle game Cylinder: Puzzles Returned. The demo features some of the single player modes and we are working on a local multiplayer update as well. ː2017stickysquirtː

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2357410/Cylinder_Puzzles_Returned/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/2357410/Cylinder_Puzzles_Returned/[/url]

Please follow our socials to keep up to date and give the game a whishlist! Thanks so much for all the Mighty Rabbit support!  ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Soundtrack now available on Steam!
notes.notes:
The Saturday Morning RPG soundtrack is now available on Steam for $6.99. This soundtrack is brought to you by legendary composers Vince DiCola (Rocky IV, Transformers: The Movie) and Kenny Meriedeth (tons of TV shows and movies from your childhood) and record label Scarlet Moon Records.

The soundtrack is available here: http://store.steampowered.com/app/325640/

Keep your eyes peeled for Episode 5 of Saturday Morning RPG which will be launching as a free update this Summer!

notes.title: February 8th Update!
notes.notes:
We've just rolled out an update for Saturday Morning RPG that adds the following things:

- Several fixes to community reported bugs
- Ability to rebind controller buttons
- Ability to set a universal volume for the game

If you have any issues with the new update, please post your bug finds on the Community Hub in the "Saturday Morning RPG Troubleshooting" thread. We will do our best to fix any and all issues you are having with the game! In the meantime, we're hard at work on Episode 5 - we hope you all are enjoying the game! Thanks for the support so far.

notes.title: Now Available on Steam - Saturday Morning RPG, 33% off!
notes.notes:
Saturday Morning RPG is Now Available on Steam and is 33% off!

Saturday Morning RPG is an episodic JRPG set in world heavily inspired by 1980s Saturday morning cartoons and pop culture. Players take the role of Martin "Marty" Michael Hall, an average high-school student who has just been granted an incredible power - a power that ultimately leads him to attract the ire of the world's most notorious villain, Commander Hood! Saturday Morning RPG features a full soundtrack by legendary 80s composer Vince DiCola (Transformers: The Animated Movie, Rocky IV) and his composing partner, Kenny Meriedeth (contributor for DuckTales, Power Rangers, X-Men, and others).


*Offer ends February 5th at 10:00 am Pacific Standard Time
